newsitem.title: USA: Credit Depot says '96 last yr of opr losses.
newsitem.headline: Credit Depot says '96 last yr of opr losses.

text.p: Credit Depot Corp said Wednesday it believes fiscal 1996 will be its last year of operating losses.
For the full year, the company said it believes it could turn profitable in the second half, and conceivably as early as the second quarter.
The statements came during a conference call with the financial community following the release of its fiscal 1996 year end earnings earlier Wednesday.

The company said it has the loan capacity to earn on the order of $4 million for fiscal 1997, pre- and post-tax reflecting the benefits of the $12.5 million loss carry-forward available, and could report something in the range of $0.60 to $0.70 cents per share for the year.
